disclaimer_cigarette.title: Disclaimer Cigarette
disclaimer_cigarette.default: The cigarette equivalent metric is based on the Berkeley Earth benchmark (~22 µg/m³ over 24 hours ≈ 1 cigarette). This is a public communication heuristic to contextualize particulate exposure, NOT a clinical diagnosis or medical equivalence.

disclaimer_baselines.title: Disclaimer Baselines
disclaimer_baselines.default: WHO 2021 (15 µg/m³) and India NAAQS (60 µg/m³) 24-hour PM2.5 levels are regulatory and scientific reference values, not a personal 'safe pollution budget'.

plants_footnote.default: Indoor plants (such as Areca Palm, Snake Plant, Peace Lily) provide psychological benefits and marginal VOC absorption under static laboratory conditions. For real-world PM2.5 particulate reduction, mechanical HEPA air purifiers, gap sealing, and timed ventilation are the primary effective measures.
